narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The front is a C, so the side view is also a C.
<bookmark mark='edge'/>Turn the C side on. The gap in the C runs away from your eye and vanishes.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>From the side you cannot see the gap at all.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check a view, look along each line of sight and ask if any cube is there.
<bookmark mark='last'/>A cube hidden behind another changes nothing in that view, so count places, not cubes.
removed_beats.on_screen: the C with its side and top views sits together; the line a hidden cube changes nothing in that view appears

old_misconception.wrong_answer: the side view is also a C
old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu says the side view is also a C. From the side, each row hides behind its first cube, so the view is a straight column.
